payload.caveat: Narrative order follows the paper. Exact experiment dates were not established; occurredAt encodes publication-order sequence.
payload.objective: Preserve the full reported decision history, including routes that were stopped.

payload.message: Record the crystallographic Moonshot starting lead and its disclosed liabilities.

payload.observation: The lead series required simultaneous mitigation of Ames risk, metabolic clearance, and racemization while maintaining Mpro potency.

payload.rationale: Retained as the structural and activity reference despite known liabilities.

payload.statement: Test three Ames-mitigation strategies in parallel.

payload.rationale: Electron-withdrawing examples lost Mpro activity; the approach was discontinued.

payload.message: Replace the amino isoquinoline with alternative heterocycles.

payload.result: Most replacements lost >3-fold potency; x42 retained potency but could oxidatively re-aromatize.

payload.rationale: The only potency-retaining replacement retained an unacceptable route back to the risky isoquinoline.

payload.message: Test the first spirocyclised hydantoin designs.

payload.result: Crystal structures aligned, but potency was not promising.

payload.rationale: The first hydantoin variants did not justify further progression.

payload.result: Significantly less potent; crystal structure showed substantial ligand displacement.

payload.rationale: Ring expansion displaced the ligand and reduced potency.

payload.message: Advance the potency-retaining spiro lactam series.

payload.result: High potency with no concerning Ames activity at tested concentrations.

payload.rationale: Selected as the tractable series for further metabolism optimization.

payload.message: Combine spiro locking with metabolism-focused changes.
Select the structurally confirmed optimized candidate.

payload.rationale: Retained as a reported optimized lead, but x38 was selected for the candidate profile.
Retained as a reported optimized lead, but x38 was selected for the candidate profile.

payload.result: Key S1/S2 contacts preserved; rat microsomal clearance improved from 605 for x1 to 16 µL/min/mg for x38.

payload.rationale: Advanced as DNDI-6510 after balancing potency, exposure, and Ames risk.

payload.endpoint: repeat dosing and nuclear hormone receptor induction
payload.result: Exposure fell on repeat dosing in rodents; cross-species assays indicated PXR-linked induction.

payload.rationale: Preclinical development was discontinued after repeat dosing could not exceed predicted efficacious human exposure in two rodent species.
